meta.format: RGBA8888 (Pillow); an indexed copy made with pngquant sits beside it as <name>.q.png

packing.note: Untrimmed grid: one row per animation, 2 px gutter, frame = sourceSize, pivot at the anchor.

pivot.note: pivot = target centre on the ground

body.note: like cartoon.js: body radius = hitbox x drawScale; art normalised so its outer ring diameter = 150 px (= 75 world units at 1:1)

memory.note: bytes once decoded to RGBA8888 (w * h * 4)

meta.notBakedIn: no squash/stretch, hit flash, low-HP tint, rotation or ground shadow (the code draws those)
meta.license: Original art generated for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower with Grok Bot GenerateImage; no third-party packs. Style reference: Brian's own enemy sprites.
meta.role: ground target warning where a coconut will land; draw under enemies
meta.scaleRule: drawScale = impactRadius_world / 37.5 (outer ring radius is 75 px = 37.5 world units at 2 px/unit); pulse alpha/scale in code if wanted

provenance.postProcess: _tools/keying.py + _tools/sheet.py (key, un-mix, cut grid cells, scale per source sheet, register on anchor, atlas)

quantizedCopy.metric: PSNR / max error on premultiplied RGBA (colour under alpha 0 ignored)
quantizedCopy.note: same layout as the RGBA original; use either (the RGBA original stays the master)
